description: Source code for a QR Code generator library, including functions for encoding data, error correction, drawing QR code modules, and mask application.

methods.name: appendBitsToBuffer
methods.description: Appends a sequence of bits to a bit buffer, updating the bit length.

methods.name: appendErrorCorrection
methods.description: Generates and appends error correction codewords to data, interleaves blocks, and stores in result.

methods.name: getNumDataCodewords
methods.description: Calculates the number of data codewords for a given version and error correction level.

methods.name: getNumRawDataModules
methods.description: Returns total number of data modules (excluding function modules) for a given version.

methods.name: calcReedSolomonGenerator
methods.description: Calculates Reed-Solomon generator polynomial coefficients.

methods.name: calcReedSolomonRemainder
methods.description: Calculates the Reed-Solomon remainder for a data polynomial.

methods.name: finiteFieldMultiply
methods.description: Multiplies two elements in GF(2^8) field.

methods.name: initializeFunctionModules
methods.description: Initializes QR code with function patterns for a specific version.

methods.name: drawWhiteFunctionModules
methods.description: Draws white modules for function patterns, excluding format bits.

methods.name: drawFormatBits
methods.description: Draws format information bits onto the QR code.

methods.name: getAlignmentPatternPositions
methods.description: Calculates positions of alignment patterns for a given QR code version.

methods.name: fillRectangle
methods.description: Fills a rectangular area with black modules.

methods.name: drawCodewords
methods.description: Draws data and error correction codewords onto the QR code modules.

methods.name: applyMask
methods.description: Applies a mask pattern to the QR code modules.

methods.name: getPenaltyScore
methods.description: Calculates penalty score for a QR code to evaluate mask quality.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (width/height) of the QR code.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Checks if a module at (x,y) is black.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets a module at (x,y) to black or white.

methods.name: setModuleBounded
methods.description: Sets a module at (x,y) if within bounds.

methods.name: qrcodegen_isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if text contains only alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: qrcodegen_isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if text contains only digits.

methods.name: qrcodegen_calcSegmentBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates buffer size needed for a segment.

methods.name: calcSegmentBitLength
methods.description: Calculates bits needed to encode a segment of given mode and length.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a byte mode segment from data.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a numeric mode segment from digit string.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates an alphanumeric mode segment from text.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeEci
methods.description: Creates an ECI mode segment with assign value.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeSegments
methods.description: Encodes segments into a QR code with default parameters.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeSegmentsAdvanced
methods.description: Encodes segments into a QR code with detailed parameters.

methods.name: getTotalBits
methods.description: Calculates total bits needed for segments at a specific version.

methods.name: numCharCountBits
methods.description: Returns bit width of character count field for mode and version.
